answer_1.quote: We test SYNCHECK and FOD on a benchmark covering four common long-form RAG tasks: question answering (QA), summarization (Summ), data-to-text (Data2txt), and biography generation.

answer_2.quote: We report two response-level metrics: faithfulness and informativeness. Faithfulness is reported as the proportion of faithful propositions within all propositions. Informativeness is reported as the number of propositions in the response. AUROC is used to evaluate faithfulness detectors.

answer_3.quote: For faithfulness evaluation we use the model proposed in Chen et al. to decompose the response into propositions, and we use retrieval+llama+npm method to factcheck each proposition directly with C as the context. We also use a pre-trained AutoAIS model to judge the faithfulness of each proposition.
